criteria.idempotent_writes: A hedged replica set may include writes on the condition that each write is idempotent and each consumer reconciles through reread: repeated application converges via idempotency, the response carries solely the winning value, and expiry of any replica continues to yield commit unknown plus supervisor escalation with no rollback or success claim.
criteria.reads_only: A hedged replica set may include solely side-effect-free reads, with writes categorically excluded: the primary missing its hedge delay always launches the second replica, hedging a write would therefore execute it twice, and the contract bars writes outright instead of depending on per-site idempotency review.

hedge_effects.instructions: Which replica effects does the hedged-request contract admit?

criteria.owner_observed: Observation of losing replicas remains entirely with the hedge owner via per-replica fates and settledAll, while the shared sink continues to capture precisely the true boundary expiries as escalation records accompanied by seq-linked late records. A post-win loser rejection that expired no boundary produces no sink entry; owner observation constitutes the whole record.
criteria.supervised_diagnostic: Upon the hedge win, transfer each outstanding loser into supervisor ownership that tracks it apart and publishes correlated diagnostics when it fails late. This erects the O2 supervised-loser lifetime and shutdown apparatus in advance of any W5 leg demanding it.

loser_observation.instructions: Where should the losing replica be observed after its hedge has been won?

criteria.failure_dominates: The hedge declares the known failure if any replica rejected and none settled, notwithstanding an expired counterpart: the tangible error points at a fault worth acting on, while the expired counterpart stays owned and its late settlement still arrives at the sink without changing the declared failure.
criteria.unknown_dominates: The hedge declares the honest unknown-write outcome if any replica expired and none settled, notwithstanding a rejected counterpart: that expired replica could have committed, the rejection cannot answer the commit question, and the unknown marker with supervisor escalation consequently takes precedence over the declared failure.

terminal_precedence.instructions: How should the hedge decide between expiry and rejection when neither replica settles?
